Everyone on this page, one tap away

Open People to chat with whoever is here, browse Public groups, or join a private group with its code.

Alt+N new group · Alt+J join with code · Alt+G public groups · Alt+P people
Alt+↑↓ switch chat · Alt+M group info · Alt+U send file · Alt+E stickers · Alt+R voice message
/ type · Esc close · Alt+S settings
Testing on your own? Open a private window, or add ?me=2 to the link for a second profile.
